execution.ref: unofficial Linux shakedown of the readiness gate on the WSL host, battery, cooling and motor at Level 0
execution.description: Ran the gate in a scratch LF clone (CPU only, no Docker, no history committed) before the official baseline.

expected: The gate would behave on Linux as on Windows, minus the host-specific failures.
observed: Digests and attack adapters were clean on an LF clone and phase4 prelive passed for battery and cooling. Two gate defects surfaced: the gate's own history file under carbon/ made the next R1 run refuse (shipped_code_has_uncommitted_changes), and cooling passed R1 on battery's phase-4 grant.
keep: Keep running the gate unofficially on the canonical host before any official baseline.
change: Write gate history and reports under docs/development/challenge_pipeline/readiness/, never under carbon/.
Make R1 use the challenge's own grant and fail closed when it has none.
Add lessons X6 and X7 to the register.
